answer: A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nebula of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
